name: MandarinClips
description: Hosted MandarinClips MCP server for TCSL educators: search 180,000+ authentic Chinese cinema dialogue clips with video turn context (previous / target / succeeding lines), HSK 3.0 grammar guides and pragmatic expression guides; every result cites its source scene on mandarinclips.com. Read-only, no auth — the free tier works anonymously with a daily quota. Also installable locally from npm as `mandarinclips-mcp` (stdio, optional MANDARINCLIPS_API_KEY for elevated quota).
author: IndexFlowing
